messages.body: guard refused: brief lacks --unattended. The Command line '/sc:analyze src/superclaude/cli/install_core.py --report-dir .dev/p1-live/guard1/' has no standalone --unattended, and both copies of analyze.md (project .claude/commands/sc/analyze.md and ~/.claude/commands/sc/analyze.md) have an '## Unattended mode' section at line 92, which is case 1 of the brief guard. Nothing was run and no contract or report was written; fix the brief by adding --unattended in a new Task.
